title: Smooth ±1 separation of two disjoint compact sets
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let K₁, K₂ ⊆ ℝ^n be disjoint compact sets. Then there is a C^∞ function g : ℝ^n → ℝ with compact support such that |g(x)| ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^n, g(x) = 1 for every x ∈ K₁, and g(x) = −1 for every x ∈ K₂.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K₁ K₂ : Set (Eucl n)), IsCompact K₁ → IsCompact K₂ → Disjoint K₁ K₂ → ∃ g : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K₁, g x = 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K₂, g x = -1)
